q: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.

s: Allah is the first the First
q: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.

s: Allah is the last the Last
q: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.

s: Surah 18: The Cave (Al-Kahf) has title Surah 18: The Cave (Al-Kahf)
Surah 18: The Cave (Al-Kahf) has source class canonical
Allah reveals the Scripture (to His slave)
q: Praise be to Allah Who hath revealed the Scripture unto His slave, and hath not placed therein any crookedness,

s: the Scripture is straight straight (without crookedness)
q: Praise be to Allah Who hath revealed the Scripture unto His slave, and hath not placed therein any crookedness,

s: the Scripture warns of stern punishment (from Allah)
q: to give warning of stern punishment from Him,

s: the Scripture gives news of a fair reward (to believers who do good works)
q: and to bring unto the believers who do good works the news that theirs will be a fair reward,

s: the believers do good works
q: Lo! as for those who believe and do good works - Lo! We suffer not the reward of one whose work is goodly to be lost.

s: the believers receive a fair reward (for belief and good works)
q: and to bring unto the believers who do good works the news that theirs will be a fair reward,

s: the believers inherit Paradise (as a reward)
q: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs are the Gardens of Paradise for welcome,

s: the disbelievers receive hell (as a reward)
q: That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers.

s: the disbelievers reject the revelations of Allah
q: Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him.

s: the People of the Cave is a young men (believers)
q: Lo! they were young men who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.

s: the People of the Cave reside in the Cave (as a refuge)
q: When the young men fled for refuge to the Cave

s: Allah guides guidance
q: He whom Allah guideth, he indeed is led aright,

s: the People of the Cave believe in Allah (as their Lord)
q: Lo! they were young men who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.

s: the People of the Cave are asleep sleep (in the Cave)
q: And thou wouldst have deemed them waking though they were asleep

s: the Cave is a refuge (for the young men)
q: When the young men fled for refuge to the Cave

s: the Cave contains the People of the Cave
q: When the young men fled for refuge to the Cave

s: the Hour is certain certainty (without doubt)
q: and that, as for the Hour, there is no doubt concerning it.

s: Paradise is a Gardens of Paradise (the welcome of believers)
q: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs are the Gardens of Paradise for welcome,

s: Paradise is eternal no removal (for its inhabitants)
q: Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence.

s: hell contains the disbelievers (as a punishment)
q: That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers.

s: Allah possesses mercy (from His presence)
q: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight.

s: the life of the world is like water (with vegetation that becomes dry twigs)
q: And coin for them the similitude of the life of the world as water which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingleth with it and then becometh dry twigs that the winds scatter.

s: the two gardens contain grapes (both gardens)
q: unto one of whom We had assigned two gardens of grapes

s: the two gardens are surrounded by date-palms (both gardens)
q: and We had surrounded both with date-palms

s: the two gardens contain tillage (between them)
q: and had put between them tillage.

s: the two gardens produce fruit (without withholding any)
q: Each of the gardens gave its fruit and withheld naught thereof.

s: the two gardens contain a river (gushing forth)
q: And We caused a river to gush forth therein.

s: the two men are comrades the garden owner's comrade (in conversation)
q: And he said unto his comrade, when he spake with him: I am more than thee in wealth, and stronger in respect of men.

s: the two men differ in wealth (one is wealthier than the other)
q: I am more than thee in wealth, and stronger in respect of men.

s: the garden owner's comrade is a believer (in Allah)
q: But He is Allah, my Lord, and I ascribe unto my Lord no partner.

s: the garden owner's comrade be less than thee (in wealth and children)
q: Though thou seest me as less than thee in wealth and children,

s: Allah is best aware of the People of the Cave (their number)
q: Say (O Muhammad): My Lord is Best Aware of their number.

s: the fish take its way into Moses's servant (being free)

q: Then found they one of Our slaves, unto whom We had given mercy from Us

s: the knowledgeable servant possesses knowledge (from Allah's presence)

q: Moses said unto him: May I follow thee, to the end that thou mayst teach me right conduct of that which thou hast been taught?

s: the ship is targeted by the king (for seizure)

s: Allah make none share in His government
